notes.title: 2023-1-17 version 1.1.2.0 update
notes.content:
1. Increase 2x acceleration function
2. Add anti-theft version detection (non steam platform will not be able to start the game)
3. The price of the game will be permanently reduced by $1 ($4.99 to $3.99)

notes.content: Fixed bug with incorrect damage calculation of "Longbowman"

notes.title: 2022-8-27 version 1.0.1.0 update
notes.content:
1.	Fix the problem that the achievement of 100% of the exploration progress cannot be completed. If your progress is 100%, you can pass any level at will and unlock it
2.	Performance Optimization: reduce GPU consumption and lock the limit frame rate to 85 frames
